_doc: See docs/art/PIPELINE.md and docs/art/classes/grounds.md. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead. '@name' values come from shared.

shared.ground: Subject: cooled volcanic ground seen from straight above, filling the whole image: dark charcoal brown-grey basalt rock #3b3330 with soft flat slightly lighter ash drifts #4a413c and a few tiny scattered dark pebbles, crossed by a few thin jagged branching cracks of glowing molten lava, bright orange #ff7a1a with small yellow #ffd04a cores and a dark rim, each crack narrow, 1 to 3 pixels wide and about one fifth of the image long, spread evenly with plenty of calm dark rock between them.
shared.ground2: Subject: a seamless top-down pixel art terrain texture of dark volcanic ground: flat dark grey-brown basalt #3b3330 with a few soft slightly lighter ash patches #4a413c and tiny dark pebbles, and a handful of thin jagged cracks glowing bright orange #ff7a1a with yellow #ffd04a centres, scattered evenly. Only the ground itself, nothing standing on it.
shared.ground3: Subject: a seamless top-down pixel art terrain texture of cooled volcanic ground: mostly smooth, flat, dark grey-brown basalt #3b3330 with soft slightly lighter ash drifts #463d38 and a few tiny dark pebbles, very calm and quiet, no cobblestones, no tile grid, no plates. Scattered evenly over it, six to eight small separate thin jagged cracks glowing bright orange #ff7a1a with yellow #ffd04a centres, each crack short, about one tenth of the image long, with lots of plain dark rock between them.
shared.base: Subject: a wide flat field of cooled dark volcanic ash and basalt seen from directly above, filling the whole image edge to edge: dark charcoal grey-brown #3b3330 with soft, slightly lighter ash drifts #463d38, a few tiny dark pebbles and faint hairline cracks, very calm, quiet and low in contrast, the same everywhere. No lava, no glow.
